userContent.text:
Build an interactive 2D figure from the brief below and the source image.

AUTHORED FIGURE BRIEF:
This figure lines up three panels, labeled (a), (b), and (c), that carry a matching problem in a bipartite graph over into a flow network. Panels (a) and (b) draw the same graph as two vertical columns of unlabeled gray circles, five in the left column beneath the italic L and four in the right column beneath R, joined by thin straight edges that always cross from one column to the other and never link two circles within a column. In (a), two edges are thickened with a gray band behind them, and no circle is an endpoint of more than one of them. In (b), three edges carry that same gray band, still with no shared endpoints, so one further circle on each side is now covered. Panel (c) redraws the arrangement with direction: a circle labeled s stands left of the L column and fans arrows into it, every L-to-R edge becomes a rightward arrow, and the R circles send arrows into a circle labeled t at the far right. The gray band in (c) traces three vertex-disjoint routes running from s all the way through to t. Holding the shaded arrows of (c) against the shaded edges of (b) is the comparison the panels invite, and together they set up the construction in which a maximum flow of unit-capacity edges delivers a matching of the largest possible cardinality.

REQUESTED INTERACTIONS:
- Toggle between panels (a), (b), and (c): the display switches from a size-2 matching to a size-3 matching to the flow network, making clear how increasing matching cardinality corresponds to adding one more disjoint route.
- Click for a shaded s-to-t route in panel (c): the full path lights up and the matching edge between L and R is highlighted in panel (b), making clear that one unit of flow represents one matched pair.
- Button for stepping through augmentation: each press adds or redirects one shaded edge until three endpoints are matched on each side, making clear how an augmenting route raises the matching size.

SOURCE FILE: Introduction to Algorithms, Figure 26.8

There is no blueprint: decide the figure type, elements, labels, controls, and any step sequence yourself.

The three panels show a size-2 matching (a), a size-3 maximum matching (b), and the corresponding flow network (c).

Step 1 / 4
View Mode
Augmentation Demo (a)

Find an alternating path to increase matching size.

Flow Network (b) & (c)

Hover or click any shaded route in (c) to trace its corresponding matched edge in (b).

// @FIGURE_CODE_BEGIN // [svgjs] const W = 900, H = 400; const draw = SVG().addTo('#container').size('100%', '100%').viewbox(0, 0, W, H); draw.css({ 'user-select': 'none' }); // Graph Definition const nodesL = 5, nodesR = 4; const edges = [ [0, 0], [1, 0], [1, 2], [2, 1], [2, 2], [3, 2], [4, 3] ]; // Original Matchings from textbook image const M_a_orig = [[0, 0], [2, 2]]; const M_b_orig = [[1, 0], [2, 1], [4, 3]]; // Styling constants const rad = 13; const colorBg = "#e0e0e0"; const colorStroke = "#333"; const thickStroke = 7; const thinStroke = 1.2; const highlightColor = "#ff8c00"; const colorAdd = "#4caf50"; const colorRemove = "#f44336"; // Coordinates const lx = 70, rx = 190; const y_startL = 60, y_stepL = 55; const y_startR = 87.5, y_stepR = 55; function getLy(i) { return y_startL + i * y_stepL; } function getRy(j) { return y_startR + j * y_stepR; } const s_pos = { x: 15, y: 170 }; const t_pos = { x: 245, y: 170 }; // Group layout for side-by-side display const gA = draw.group().translate(20, 0); const gB = draw.group().translate(320, 0); const gC = draw.group().translate(620, 0); // Helper to prevent markers from drawing inside/underneath circle radii function shortenLine(x1, y1, x2, y2, r1, r2) { const dx = x2 - x1, dy = y2 - y1; const len = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy); if (len === 0) return {x1, y1, x2, y2}; return { x1: x1 + (dx/len) * r1, y1: y1 + (dy/len) * r1, x2: x2 - (dx/len) * r2, y2: y2 - (dy/len) * r2 }; } // Arrow marker const markerId = 'arrow-c'; draw.marker(8, 8, function(add) { add.path('M 0 0 L 8 4 L 0 8 z').fill('#333'); }).id(markerId).ref(8, 4); function drawBipartite(parent, isC) { const thickLayer = parent.group(); const edgeLayer = parent.group(); const nodeLayer = parent.group(); const labelLayer = parent.group(); const edgeElements = {}; const thickElements = {}; let s_edges = [], t_edges = []; // Edges between L and R edges.forEach(([u, v]) => { const y1 = getLy(u), y2 = getRy(v); const p = shortenLine(lx, y1, rx, y2, 0, isC ? rad + 2 : 0); const thick = thickLayer.line(lx, y1, rx, y2) .stroke({ color: '#bbb', width: thickStroke, linecap: 'round' }).hide(); const thin = edgeLayer.line(p.x1, p.y1, p.x2, p.y2) .stroke({ color: colorStroke, width: thinStroke }); if (isC) thin.marker('end', `url(#${markerId})`); edgeElements[`${u}-${v}`] = thin; thickElements[`${u}-${v}`] = thick; }); if (isC) { // s to L edges for(let i=0; i { el.hide().stroke({color: '#bbb'}); }); if (isC) { obj.s_edges.forEach(e => { e.thick.hide().stroke({color: '#bbb'}); }); obj.t_edges.forEach(e => { e.thick.hide().stroke({color: '#bbb'}); }); } matching.forEach(([u, v]) => { obj.thickElements[`${u}-${v}`].show(); if (isC) { obj.s_edges[u].thick.show(); obj.t_edges[v].thick.show(); } }); } // Initial draw setMatching(objA, M_a_orig, false); setMatching(objB, M_b_orig, false); setMatching(objC, M_b_orig, true); // --------------------------------------------------------- // Interaction 1: Flow Network Hover & Click // --------------------------------------------------------- let current_clickC = -1; M_b_orig.forEach(([u, v], idx) => { const hitGroup = gC.group(); const drawHit = (x1, y1, x2, y2) => { hitGroup.line(x1, y1, x2, y2).stroke({width: 24, opacity: 0}).css('cursor', 'pointer'); }; drawHit(s_pos.x, s_pos.y, lx, getLy(u)); drawHit(lx, getLy(u), rx, getRy(v)); drawHit(rx, getRy(v), t_pos.x, t_pos.y); hitGroup .on('mouseenter', () => { if(current_clickC !== idx) hitGroup.css('opacity', 0.5); }) .on('mousemove', (e) => showTooltip('Click to trace this route in (b)', e)) .on('mouseleave', () => { hideTooltip(); hitGroup.css('opacity', 1); }) .on('click', () => { window.trigger_clickC(idx); }); }); window.trigger_clickC = function(idx) { if (current_clickC === idx) idx = -1; window.update_clickC(idx); // Auto shift view to show B and C clearly if not already if (document.getElementById('viewAInput').checked) { window.update_view('all'); } }; window.update_clickC = function(idx) { current_clickC = idx; setMatching(objB, M_b_orig, false); setMatching(objC, M_b_orig, true); if (idx >= 0) { const [u, v] = M_b_orig[idx]; objC.s_edges[u].thick.stroke({color: highlightColor}); objC.thickElements[`${u}-${v}`].stroke({color: highlightColor}); objC.t_edges[v].thick.stroke({color: highlightColor}); objB.thickElements[`${u}-${v}`].stroke({color: highlightColor}); } }; // --------------------------------------------------------- // Interaction 2: Augmentation Demo // --------------------------------------------------------- let aug_state = 0; window.trigger_augment = function() { window.update_augment((aug_state + 1) % 3); window.update_view('a'); // ensure focus on A }; window.update_augment = function(state) { aug_state = state; const btn = document.getElementById('btnAugment'); if (state === 0) { setMatching(objA, M_a_orig, false); Object.values(objA.thickElements).forEach(el => { if (!el.visible()) el.stroke({color: '#bbb'}); }); btn.textContent = "Find Augmenting Path"; btn.style.background = "#e8f4f8"; } else if (state === 1) { setMatching(objA, M_a_orig, false); // Path: L1(unmatched) -> R2 -> L2 -> R1(unmatched) const augPath = [[1,2], [2,2], [2,1]]; augPath.forEach(([u,v], i) => { const el = objA.thickElements[`${u}-${v}`]; el.show().stroke({color: (i % 2 === 0) ? colorAdd : colorRemove}); }); btn.textContent = "Apply Augmentation"; btn.style.background = "#e8f8e8"; } else if (state === 2) { // New matching of size 3 setMatching(objA, [[0,0], [1,2], [2,1]], false); btn.textContent = "Reset Augmentation"; btn.style.background = "#f8e8e8"; } }; // --------------------------------------------------------- // Interaction 3: View Toggles & Step Player // --------------------------------------------------------- window.update_view = function(mode) { const rd = document.getElementById('view' + mode.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + mode.slice(1) + 'Input'); if (rd) rd.checked = true; gA.animate(250).opacity(mode === 'all' || mode === 'a' ? 1 : 0.12); gB.animate(250).opacity(mode === 'all' || mode === 'b' ? 1 : 0.12); gC.animate(250).opacity(mode === 'all' || mode === 'c' ? 1 : 0.12); }; const demoSteps = [ { view: 'all', aug: 0, clickC: -1, text: "The three panels show a size-2 matching (a), a size-3 maximum matching (b), and the corresponding flow network (c)." }, { view: 'all', aug: 0, clickC: 1, text: "A matching corresponds to disjoint paths in the flow network. Each unit of flow (like the highlighted path) represents one matched edge." }, { view: 'a', aug: 1, clickC: -1, text: "How do we find a larger matching? In panel (a), we can trace an 'augmenting path' alternating between unmatched (green) and matched (red) edges." }, { view: 'a', aug: 2, clickC: -1, text: "Swapping the matched states along this route adds one edge to the matching overall, successfully augmenting its size." } ]; let currentStep = 0; function applyStep(i) { currentStep = Math.max(0, Math.min(demoSteps.length - 1, i)); const s = demoSteps[currentStep]; window.update_view(s.view); window.update_augment(s.aug); window.update_clickC(s.clickC); document.getElementById('demoNarration').textContent = s.text; document.getElementById('stepLabel').textContent = `Step ${currentStep + 1} / ${demoSteps.length}`; } window.prevStep = function() { applyStep(currentStep - 1); }; window.nextStep = function() { applyStep(currentStep + 1); }; applyStep(0); window.__markRendered(); // @FIGURE_CODE_END
